description: Run a shell command and return its output. The command is risk-classified first. Read-only commands run straight away; anything that deletes, kills, installs or needs root asks you to confirm. Outright dangerous patterns are refused. The working directory persists between calls: after 'cd build' the next command starts in build, and every result ends with '[cwd: ...]'. Output longer than a few thousand characters is kept in a file; the result shows the start and end and names the file to open with read_file or search_text. A command that has not finished at its timeout keeps running as a background job; check it with command_status and stop it with stop_command. With sandbox the command runs in a read-only, no-network, isolated sandbox where it cannot change anything.
name: run_command

background.description: Start the command and return a job id at once, without waiting. Use for servers, watchers, builds and anything that takes minutes; at most 3 can run at a time. Default: False.

sandbox.description: Try a command, or inspect its effect, safely before running it for real. It runs with a read-only filesystem, no network, no desktop or session bus and no view of host processes, so it cannot change anything and needs no confirmation (unless it reads a secret file). Writes fail or vanish. If the sandbox is unavailable the command is refused, never run unsandboxed. Default: False.

timeout_seconds.description: Wait this long for the result (1-600). Then the command moves to a background job instead of being killed. Default: 60.

working_directory.description: Directory to run it in. Defaults to the directory of the previous command, or your home at the start. Default: ''.

prompt.description: For kind=notify, the message to show. For kind=agent, the request to run — write it exactly as the user would say it.

repeat.description: A 5-field cron expression for a recurring job, e.g. "0 9 * * *" for every day at 9am, "0 9 * * 1" for Mondays. Default: ''.

speak.description: Also say it out loud when it fires. Default: False.

when.description: An absolute ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. "2026-09-07T17:00". Resolve any relative phrasing yourself — "tomorrow", "next Tuesday", "in two weeks" — using the current date and time given in the context, and pass the resulting absolute timestamp. A plain duration ("20m", "1h30m", "2d") is also accepted. Leave empty when using repeat. Default: ''.

description: Show the status of one systemd unit.
name: service_status

system_scope.description: Query the system manager instead of the user one. Default: False.

description: Switch the desktop between light and dark.
name: set_dark_mode

enabled.description: True for dark, False for light, omit to toggle.

description: Say something out loud through the speakers.
name: speak

blocking.description: Wait for it to finish before returning. Default: False.

description: Play something in Spotify, or show what Spotify is playing right now.
name: spotify

action.description: play or status. Default: 'play'.

what.description: For play: 'liked songs', a Spotify URI, or free text to search for.

description: Stop any speech that is currently playing.
name: stop_speaking

description: Switch to a workspace and confirm the user is really there.
name: switch_workspace

workspace.description: Workspace number as shown on the bar (e.g. '3') or a workspace name. On niri, 'next'/'down' and 'previous'/'up' move one workspace down or up (niri workspaces are stacked vertically).

description: Report overall machine health: CPU, memory, disk, uptime and load.
name: system_status

detailed.description: Include per-core CPU, temperatures and network counters. Default: False.

description: Capture the screen to a PNG file.
name: take_screenshot

active_window.description: Capture only the focused window. Default: False.

region.description: Interactively select a region with the mouse. Default: False.

save_path.description: Where to save it. Defaults to the cache directory. Default: ''.

description: Type a command into an already-open terminal window and run it. Use `run_command` instead when you only need the output — this exists for commands that must run in a terminal the user can watch.
name: type_into_terminal

press_enter.description: Press Return after typing. Set false to leave it staged. Default: True.

query.description: Which terminal — app name or part of its title. Omit for the focused window. Default: ''.

workspace.description: Only consider terminals on this workspace. Default: ''.

description: Type text into whatever currently has keyboard focus.
name: type_text

description: Trigger updates for installed games. Steam updates its own titles on launch, so this opens the downloads page; Legendary can be driven directly.
name: update_games

description: Read or control this computer's speaker volume. For the phone use phone_set_volume.
name: volume

action.description: get; set (needs percent); change (needs delta, default +10); mute (state, omit to toggle). Default: 'get'.

delta.description: For change: signed percentage change, e.g. 10 or -10.

state.description: For mute: True to mute, False to unmute, omit to toggle.

description: Set the desktop wallpaper, or report which wallpaper tool this session can use.
name: wallpaper

action.description: set (needs path) or status. Default: 'status'.

path.description: For set: an image file or URL.

description: Get the current weather and a short forecast.
name: weather

city.description: City name. Omit to use your approximate location. Default: ''.

description: Search the web and return result titles, snippets and links.
name: web_search

max_results.description: How many results to return. Default: 6.

description: Find where a command lives on PATH.
name: which_command

description: Find which package provides a file or command.
name: which_package_owns

target.description: A command name or absolute file path.

description: Turn Wi-Fi on or off, check its state, or list visible networks.
name: wifi_control

action.description: 'on', 'off', 'toggle', 'status', or 'list' for visible networks. Default: 'status'.

rescan.description: For list: force a fresh scan first. Default: False.

description: Toggle fullscreen, or tiling/floating, on the focused window.
name: window_state

description: Create or overwrite a text file. Overwriting an existing file needs a read_file of it first; prefer edit_file for changing part of a file.
name: write_file

append.description: Append instead of replacing the file. Default: False.
